comparison.objective: Finish only the unpainted portions of a panel without excessive repainting or table contamination; candidate rejects only open cartons and leaves closed cartons untouched.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1530 tests visual region discrimination, continuous roller contact, coverage planning and boundary control. Candidate tests moving rigid-body grasping, articulated-flap avoidance and payload-preserving transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1530 grades painted-cell coverage, wasted overlap and table contact, with 1 s full-score dwell. Candidate grades per-carton removal/pass outcomes, retained contents, release clearance and 3 s stability.
comparison.reason: Both require acting only on selected regions or objects, but that generic selectivity does not make surface coating equivalent to conveyor carton handling.
